notes: V35 (CR 704.5d, 111.7): Goblin Wizardry makes two 1/1 Goblin Wizard tokens. Pestilent Haze ('All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn') is a noncreature spell, so their prowess makes them 2/2 first, then the Haze kills them. Tokens that leave the battlefield cease to exist: the graveyard holds only the two spells, never the tokens.
